verdict: A deployment-type script (detection or install) exceeded its execution timeout.
fix: Raise the `Maximum allowed run time` on the deployment type. If the script is a detection rule, optimize it: detection scripts should complete in seconds, not minutes - avoid `Get-ChildItem -Recurse` on large trees and prefer registry or file-version checks. If the script legitimately takes time (e.g. database query), put the slow work in a scheduled prerequisite, not the detection rule.
